# iosxe_wireless_mesh_profile (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_mesh_profile" "example" {
  profile_name       = "S2-MESH-OUTDOOR"
  description        = "Outdoor mesh profile"
  convergence_method = "mesh-convergence-fast"
  multicast_mode     = "mesh-multicast-mode-in"
  range              = 20000
  security_mode      = "mesh-security-mode-psk"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_name` (String)

### Optional

- `convergence_method` (String) - Choices: `mesh-convergence-standard`, `mesh-convergence-fast`, `mesh-convergence-veryfast`, `mesh-convergence-noise-tolerant-fast`
- `description` (String)
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `multicast_mode` (String) - Choices: `mesh-multicast-mode-regular`, `mesh-multicast-mode-in`, `mesh-multicast-mode-inout`
- `range` (Number)
- `security_mode` (String) - Choices: `mesh-security-mode-eap`, `mesh-security-mode-psk`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_mesh_profile.example "<profile_name>"
```
